notes: Conformance source fixtures for JVM, Java Native Image, and LLVM. LLVM native stage 1 admits only i64 specialization. Treat unsupported non-scalar forms as explicit diagnostic outcomes, not native acceptance.

cases.source:
fnc sum<A, B=A, C=B, D=C>(A x, B y): int { return x + y; }
pub fnc main(): int { return sum<A=int, D=int>(19, 23); }

fnc identity<A, B=int>(A value): A { return value; }
pub fnc main(): int { return identity<_, B=int>(42); }

fnc add<A, B=int, C=B>(A x, B y): int { return x + y; }
pub fnc main(): int { return add<C=int, A=int>(19, 23); }

fnc fixed<T=int>(): int { return 42; }
pub fnc main(): int { return fixed<_>(); }

fnc fixed<A, A=int>(): int { return 42; }
pub fnc main(): int { return fixed<int>(); }

fnc fixed<A=B, B=int>(): int { return 42; }
pub fnc main(): int { return fixed<int>(); }
